scene: The tram slows to the interchange, revealing three awaiting connections outside.
picture: Side-view pixel art at the open-air tram terminus platform. Left stands the bearded player stepping down from the yellow tram. Far left, an open window-cleaner gondola hangs ready. Centre sits a squat green mail train accepting heavy sacks. Right, a bright yellow neon-striped tow truck idles beside a glowing exit ramp.
shown: a suspended window-cleaner gondola swinging empty by open doors on the left
a squat green mail train puffing steam along the platform centre
a yellow neon-striped tow truck idling with flashing lights far right
